# te_tax_light_rung_<key>: the step the enacted rate sits on, the lowest native level whose
# rate under the active law is at least the code's (0 very low .. 4 very high); -1 for a tax
# the law does not levy. Literal thresholds per law.
te_tax_light_rung_wage = {
	value = -1
	if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation has_variable = te_tax_en_wage }
		value = 4
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage <= 5 } value = 3 }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage <= 4 } value = 2 }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage <= 3 } value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage <= 2 } value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation has_variable = te_tax_en_wage }
		value = 4
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage <= 10 } value = 3 }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage <= 8 } value = 2 }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage <= 6 } value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage <= 4 } value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation has_variable = te_tax_en_wage }
		value = 4
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage <= 7 } value = 3 }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage <= 6 } value = 2 }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage <= 5 } value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage <= 4 } value = 0 }
	}
}

# te_tax_light_rc_<key>_<ig>: a +1 index step's reaction score for the group, before the
# pleasing weight: the support model's material reason (MATERIAL_WEIGHT x exposure x
# levels) plus its ideology reason (IDEOLOGY_WEIGHT x levels x +-1 x te_tax_ideo_p_<ig>,
# + for wages and dividends, - for the others), levels = step / LEVEL_STEPS.

# te_tax_light_rlv_<ig>: the relief the group's members get, in vanilla tax levels of a tax
# they pay in full: over the taxes the active law levies, its exposure (EXPOSURE) times
# each tax's relief steps (te_tax_light_rl_<key>, written by te_tax_light_gen_relief) times
# one step in levels.
te_tax_light_rlv_armed_forces = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rl_cons } add = { value = var:te_tax_light_rl_cons multiply = 0.4 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rl_land } add = { value = var:te_tax_light_rl_land multiply = 0.01667 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rl_cons } add = { value = var:te_tax_light_rl_cons multiply = 0.4 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rl_wage } add = { value = var:te_tax_light_rl_wage multiply = 0.15 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rl_land } add = { value = var:te_tax_light_rl_land multiply = 0.01667 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rl_head } add = { value = var:te_tax_light_rl_head multiply = 0.1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rl_cons } add = { value = var:te_tax_light_rl_cons multiply = 0.4 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rl_wage } add = { value = var:te_tax_light_rl_wage multiply = 0.15 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rl_div } add = { value = var:te_tax_light_rl_div multiply = 0.1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rl_cons } add = { value = var:te_tax_light_rl_cons multiply = 0.4 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rl_wage } add = { value = var:te_tax_light_rl_wage multiply = 0.15 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rl_div } add = { value = var:te_tax_light_rl_div multiply = 0.1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rl_cons } add = { value = var:te_tax_light_rl_cons multiply = 0.4 } }
	}
}

# Panel views (gui/journal_entry_widgets/te_tax_light_widget.gui): guarded reads, -1 or 0
# when absent.
te_tax_view_light_on = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { te_tax_light_in_force = yes } value = 1 }
}

	value = -1
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_light_level } value = var:te_tax_light_level }
}
